business_problem: ICA Sverige wanted to shift from product-centric campaigns to hyper-personalized loyalty engagement, but fragmented customer data, paper-based communications, slow campaign cycles, and rule-based offer allocation prevented the retailer from understanding customers well enough to target them effectively.
solution_summary: TCS helped ICA Sverige build a near-real-time customer data foundation for loyalty and marketing personalization. The implementation started with a data analytics platform and data hub that consolidated information from ICA's retail, banking, insurance, pharmacy, and campaign systems into a 360-degree customer view. TCS then connected a digital marketing suite so downstream applications could pull customer insights, dynamic segments, and campaign triggers from the same foundation instead of relying on static rules or batch lists. As the platform matured, TCS evolved it into a real-time marketing data hub that supports advanced analytics and algorithmic recommendation, giving marketing teams a governed way to allocate personalized and goal-based offers while measuring engagement and pruning low-performing campaigns. The result was a reusable decision layer for targeted loyalty communications rather than one-off campaign execution.

solution_components.name: data analytics platform
solution_components.role: Processes customer information and supports the advanced analytics needed for targeted campaigns and measurement.

solution_components.name: data hub
solution_components.role: Stores the unified 360-degree customer view that marketing and downstream applications consume.

solution_components.name: digital marketing suite
solution_components.role: Uses the unified customer view to deliver communications and offer allocations across marketing journeys.

solution_components.name: algorithmic recommendation
solution_components.role: Turns curated customer data and segments into hyper-personalized offer suggestions.

data_flow: Customer data from ICA's retail and adjacent businesses is consolidated into a data hub and processed by the data analytics platform to maintain a near-real-time 360-degree customer view. The digital marketing suite and downstream applications consume those insights, dynamic segments, and algorithmic recommendations to run hyper-personalized campaigns and measure performance across customer touchpoints.
business_outcome: ICA Sverige moved from slow, rule-based campaign operations to near-real-time targeted marketing, raised redemption on flagship campaigns, reduced wasted spend on low-performing promotions, and built a reusable customer-data foundation for loyalty growth across the enterprise.
metrics: The offer redemption rate for flagship communications increased fourfold to between 22% and 42%.
99% of customer communication was through physical letters
Campaign communication cycle time was between three and five weeks.
1.6 million SEK ($0.15 million) annual savings in licensing cost
Five touchpoints enabled to track customer behavior
The bottom 20% of non-performing campaigns in terms of monetary impact and customer engagement are periodically discontinued.

Digital marketing data is ingested back into the platform for a closed-loop customer view.
Downstream applications fetch insights from the platform for campaign execution.
Dynamic customer segments and algorithmic recommendation sit on top of the real-time marketing data hub.
